summary: Verified bug fix in ClienteForm: disabling 'Motore presente' switch hides ONLY engine-specific fields (HP, olio, candele, termostati, girante) while keeping all other optional services (antivegetativa, scafo sporco, copertura, lavaggio inizio/fine, alaggio/varo) visible and interactive. Client save with motore=OFF works correctly (total 1650€ calculated with antivegetativa + lavaggio + alaggio/varo × 2, no engine cost). Cleanup completed.
critical_code_review_comments: ClienteForm.jsx (~870 lines) is large — consider splitting Motore/Costi/LavorazioniExtra into subcomponents for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted a test cliente 'TESTBUG MotoreOff' during test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug from iteration 13 (motore switch OFF hiding all optional services) is fixed. Verified via UI e2e on /clienti. Motor fields + girante hide; antivegetativa/scafo/copertura/lavaggi/alaggio-varo remain visible. Save works. Total computed on server includes non-engine costs when primo_motore_attivo=false.
rca of the issue: Previously the entire optional-services block was rendered inside the {primo_motore_attivo && (...)} conditional. Fix: moved the ToggleRow grid (antivegetativa, scafo_sporco, copertura, lavaggio_inizio, lavaggio_fine, alaggio_varo) OUTSIDE the conditional; only HP/olio/candele/termostati inputs and the 'Sostituzione girante' toggle remain inside the {primo_motore_attivo !== false} branch. Backend calcola_costi already zeroes only manodopera+ricambi motore when primo_motore_attivo=false.
